title: 第22章 老头，你找死啊！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚大结局全文免费阅读
content_zh: 楼顶，老将军背着双手，意气风发。看着状元街震惊的重任，又看了一眼酒楼中咬牙切齿的刘温等大臣，他心头那是一个畅快。哈哈，你们平时不是很牛逼吗？平时左一句粗鄙武夫，右一句粗俗野人，现在傻眼了吧？当然，更让狄苍期待的是，要是这群家伙知道他们心心念念要找出来的小诗仙，就是他们最看不上的唐逸，脸色还不知道有多精彩呢！“诸位，老子就问你们，小诗仙为老夫量身打造的这首诗，怎么样？”狄苍案首挺胸，老脸上满是嘚瑟。听到他的话，状元街上静了一瞬，瞬间就爆炸了。“老将军，这是一首绝世无双的好词！”“不愧是小诗仙，服了，不服都不行。”“老将军，小诗仙究竟是谁？能说说吗？”“……”刘温和唐敬一群大臣看着状元街上沸腾的人群，气得脸色铁青，愤怒到发狂。他们还想将小诗仙揪出来凌迟，却没想到小诗仙反手就是一个巴掌，当着众人的面直接打在了他们脸上，啪啪作响！他们讨厌狄苍这老匹夫，他却用一首词，让狄苍给千古流芳了。他们心心念念想要千古留名的事，却让狄苍轻而易举做到了！这让很多大臣当场就破防了。啪！刘温怒火中烧，一巴掌拍在桌上，指着狄苍喝问：“老东西，小诗仙是谁？”狄苍抱着双手，鼻孔朝天：“小诗仙是谁？你们不配知道。”“好好享受吧，你们的灾难，才刚刚开始！”狄苍大笑一声，转身离开了。看着狄苍的背影，唐敬、刘温一群人脸色阴沉至极。小诗仙必须尽快揪出来！不然任由他这般胡搞，他们将会是整个大炎的笑话。唐逸自然不知道自己抄的一首词，引起了那群大臣多大的仇恨，这时的他，正悠哉地带着唐音，前往朱雀大街收酒楼。“哥哥，我不是打击你，你这一壶酒……真能为酒楼扬名？”唐音看着唐逸手中提着的酒坛，大眼睛里满是怀疑。哥哥说这是绝世美酒，可她昨天明明见到这不过是哥哥用一车普通的酒煮出来的，叫什么白酒，名字听起来就很奇怪好吧！“当然，这将是咱们酒楼的招牌之一。”唐逸扬了扬手中的蒸馏酒。这个时代的好酒，喝起来和水没太大区别。酒精度高达五十的酒，在这个时代那才是真正的美酒。这是他用来给酒楼打广告用的，虽然酒楼还没正式开业，但广告打出去了，那开业的时候不至于太冷清。他可不想让颜霜玉母子看笑话。很快，马车在迎客楼外停下。从马车上跳下来，唐逸和唐音手牵着手就在风中凌乱了。左边是迎客楼，右边是天香楼，都是酒楼，却是两极分化。天香楼宾客络绎不绝，热闹不已。而迎客楼……一个客人都没有。“海爷，你行行好，千万别砸啊！”“真不是不将公主府放在眼里，是我们老板不在，我们说了不算啊！”这时，酒楼中传来了争吵声。这是有人来找麻烦？唐逸眉头微皱，拉着唐音进了酒楼。刚进酒楼，一个身材肥胖的中年男人就见到了他，眼睛瞬间亮了起来。他立即指着唐逸道：“海爷，这位就是我们的新老板，唐家四少唐逸。”“海爷你有什么话，直接找我们老板，我们老板说了算。”唐逸认识掌柜，是颜霜玉的一个远房表舅，李有财。同时，也是唐画和唐浩的头号狗腿，由于他经常去唐家，没少帮着唐画和唐浩欺凌前身。“怎么回事？”唐逸皱眉问道。前方是个穿着蓝衣的青年，而青年的身后，还跟着两个身材魁梧肌肉炸裂的男人。看上去就不好惹。“哦？你就是新任老板？”青年打量了一下唐逸，笑道：“小老板你怎么回事？报名参加我天香楼举办的斗酒大会，却给我们普通得不能再普通的酒，是觉得我天香楼好糊弄吗？”融合前身记忆后，唐逸瞬间明白了这斗酒大会是怎么回事。斗酒大会每年由天香楼主持，京都各大酒楼和酒商参与，汇集京都的所有美酒供给十位裁判品尝，胜出者，美酒将会被挂在天香楼楼顶。而只要胜出，美酒将会给酒楼或者酒商带来泼天的富贵。甚至，极有可能成为宫廷御酒！只是此时听完青年的话，唐逸嘴角不由抽了抽，妈的，这分明就是颜霜玉挖的坑。唐逸看向李有财，李有财立即弯着腰，满脸恭敬。只是嘴角却充满嘲讽，眼中也满是戏谑。他是酒楼的老板，每年在账簿上做点手脚，就能轻轻松松顺走几百两。现在唐逸来当老板，那就是挡他的财路。谁挡他的财路，他就要谁死！唐逸没有和李有财说什么，只是看向魏海道：“魏兄，我不记得有报名参加斗酒大会，这其中可能有误会。”魏海眼睛眯了起来，上下打量着唐逸，确定他并不知情后，心里大概也猜测到了一些东西。显然，是有人想要借他天香楼的刀杀人啊！他看向唐逸的目光，顿时就变得怜悯起来，指着李有财说道：“可能的确是有一点误会，但昨日李掌柜贿赂了我五百两，要我将迎客楼的斗酒名额加上去。”“名单我们魏总管已经看过了，已经没有了反悔的余地。”魏海盯着唐逸，嘴角虽然带笑，但声音却充满冷意。“小老板，别怪我没提醒你，今天是最后的机会。”“你今日要是无法给出美酒，为半月后的斗酒大会做准备，我会被魏总管弄死。”“但在我死之前，我肯定会弄死你。”唐逸脸色难看下来，难怪颜霜玉放手放得那么干脆，还真是给他挖了一个大坑啊！要不是他阴差阳错提前搞了蒸馏酒，今天拿不出好酒给魏海，恐怕明年的今天，就是他的忌日了。“老板，我是按照你的命令，贿赂魏爷报名的，你不能不认账啊！”“要是拿不出参赛美酒，我们真的都会死的。”李有财丝毫不在意魏浩点出他贿赂的事，指着站在酒楼中的一群小二和厨师义愤填膺道：“老板，他们都只是普通人，上有老下有小，你不能不管他们的死活啊！”唐逸看着李有财颠倒黑白加道德绑架，嘴角泛起冷笑。老头，你还真是找死啊！
content_en: On the top of the building, the old general clasped his hands behind his back and looked high-spirited.Looking at the shocked heavy duty in Zhuangyuan Street, and then looking at Liu Wen and other ministers who were gnashing their teeth in the restaurant, he felt happy in his heart.Haha, aren’t you usually awesome?Normally, one sentence on the left is a vulgar martial artist, and one sentence on the right is a vulgar savage. Are you dumbfounded now?Of course, what Di Cang is even more looking forward to is that if these guys know that the little Shixian they are eager to find is Tang Yi, whom they despise the most, their expressions will be amazing!"Everyone, I would like to ask you, what do you think of this poem that the little Shixian made for me?" Di Cang raised his head and raised his chest, his old face full of embarrassment.After hearing his words, Zhuangyuan Street was silent for a moment, and then exploded."Old General, this is an unparalleled poem!" "As expected of the Little Poet Fairy, it doesn't matter if you accept it or not." "Old General, who is the Little Poet Fairy? Can you tell me?" "..." Liu Wen and Tang Jing and a group of ministers looked at the boiling crowd on Zhuangyuan Street, their faces were livid with anger, and they were mad with anger.They also wanted to pull out Ling Chi from Xiao Shixian, but they didn't expect Xiao Shixian's backhand to slap them directly in the face in front of everyone, making a crackling sound!They hated Di Cang, an old man, but he used a poem to make Di Cang famous forever.They wanted to leave their names for eternity, but Di Cang did it easily!This caused many ministers to break their guard on the spot.Snap!Liu Wen was furious, slapped his hand on the table, pointed at Di Cang and asked: "Old man, who is the little Poet Fairy?" Di Cang held his hands and raised his nostrils to the sky: "Who is the Little Poet Fairy? You don't deserve to know." "Enjoy it, your disaster has just begun!" Di Cang laughed, turned and left.Looking at Di Cang's back, Tang Jing and Liu Wen's expressions were extremely gloomy.Xiao Shixian must be found out as soon as possible!Otherwise, if he is allowed to mess around like this, they will become a joke to the whole Dayan.Naturally, Tang Yi didn't know how much hatred a poem he copied aroused from those ministers. At this time, he was leisurely taking Tang Yin to Zhuque Street to close the restaurant."Brother, I'm not trying to hit you. This bottle of wine...can you really make the restaurant famous?" Tang Yin looked at the wine jar in Tang Yi's hand, his big eyes full of doubt.Her brother said this was a peerless wine, but yesterday she saw that it was just a car of ordinary wine cooked by her brother. What kind of liquor is it called? The name sounds weird, right?"Of course, this will be one of the signatures of our restaurant." Tang Yi raised the distilled wine in his hand.The good wine of this era tastes not much different from water.Wine with an alcohol content of up to 50 is a real wine in this era.This is what he uses to advertise the restaurant. Although the restaurant has not officially opened yet, the advertisement is out, so it won't be too deserted when it opens.He didn't want Yan Shuangyu and his son to see the joke.Soon, the carriage stopped outside the guest building.Jumping off the carriage, Tang Yi and Tang Yin held hands and became messy in the wind.On the left is the Yingke Building, and on the right is the Tianxiang Building. They are both restaurants, but they are polarizing.There is an endless stream of guests in Tianxiang Tower and it is very lively.And the guest building... there wasn't a single guest."Hai Ye, please do a good job and don't smash it!" "It's not that we don't take the Princess' Mansion seriously, it's just that our boss isn't here, so what we say doesn't count!" At this time, there was a quarrel in the restaurant.Is this someone looking for trouble?Tang Yi frowned slightly and pulled Tang Yin into the restaurant.As soon as he entered the restaurant, a fat middle-aged man saw him, and his eyes lit up instantly.He immediately pointed at Tang Yi and said, "Master Hai, this is our new boss, Tang Yi, the fourth young master of the Tang family." "Master Hai, if you have any questions, please go directly to our boss. Our boss has the final say." Tang Yi knew the shopkeeper, Li Youcai, a distant cousin of Yan Shuangyu.At the same time, he was also Tang Hua and Tang Hao's number one loser. Because he often went to Tang's house, he often helped Tang Hua and Tang Hao bully their predecessors."What's going on?" Tang Yi asked with a frown.In front of him was a young man in blue clothes, and behind him were two men with burly bodies and bursting muscles.It doesn't look easy to mess with."Oh? Are you the new boss?" The young man looked Tang Yi up and down and said with a smile: "Little boss, what's the matter with you? You signed up to participate in the drinking competition held by Tianxiang House, but we were given ordinary wine. Do you think Tianxiang House is easy to fool?" After merging the memories of his predecessor, Tang Yi instantly understood what the drinking competition was about.The wine fighting conference is hosted by Tianxiang Tower every year, and major restaurants and wine merchants in Kyoto participate. All the fine wines in Kyoto are brought together for ten judges to taste. The winner's wine will be hung on the roof of Tianxiang Tower.And as long as you win, the wine will bring great wealth to the restaurant or wine merchant.It is even very possible to become the royal wine of the palace!But after listening to the young man's words, Tang Yi couldn't help but twitch the corner of his mouth. Damn it, this is clearly the hole dug by Yan Shuangyu.Tang Yi looked at Li Youcai, who immediately bent over with respect on his face.But the corners of his mouth were full of sarcasm, and his eyes were full of teasing.He is the owner of a restaurant. He can easily make hundreds of taels off every year by doing some tricks on the account books.Now that Tang Yilai is the boss, it means blocking his way to make money.Anyone who blocks his way to make money will die!Tang Yi didn't say anything to Li Youcai. He just looked at Wei Hai and said, "Brother Wei, I don't remember signing up for the drinking competition. There may be a misunderstanding." Wei Hai narrowed his eyes and looked Tang Yi up and down. After confirming that he didn't know anything, he probably guessed something in his mind.Obviously, someone wanted to borrow his Tianxianglou knife to kill someone!He looked at Tang Yi and suddenly became sympathetic. He pointed at Li Youcai and said, "There may be a misunderstanding, but yesterday shopkeeper Li bribed me five hundred taels and asked me to add the quota for the wine fight in the guest building." "We, Manager Wei, have already seen the list, and there is no room for regret." Wei Hai stared at Tang Yi, although he was smiling, his voice was full of coldness."Little boss, don't blame me for not reminding you, today is your last chance." "If you can't give me wine today to prepare for the wine fight in half a month, I will be killed by Manager Wei." "But before I die, I will definitely kill you." Tang Yi's face turned ugly. No wonder Yan Shuangyu let go so simply, she really dug a big hole for him!If he hadn't made distilled liquor by mistake and couldn't give Wei Hai good liquor today, I'm afraid today would be his death anniversary next year."Boss, I am following your order to bribe
